courses.name: AI in Accounting & Finance
taughtSkills: managing and preparing data for analysis
using AI to automate financial analysis and generate accounting reports
building predictive models to inform business decisions
coding customized solutions with R and Python
integrating statistical libraries for data analysis
using modern tools (Keras, TensorFlow, Hadoop, Spark, Cloud) to automate accounting and finance processes
courses.levelNote: Prerequisite is BC2406, itself a course with its own standing prerequisite, forming a deeper two-step chain; assigned level 3000, consistent with its 3000-series catalog code.

evidence.quote: This is an introductory course designed for business or accountancy or Finance undergraduate students who are interested to learn how to manage data, conduct business analytics programmatically, create AI model to automate business processes and create predictive model to increase profitability or return. ... The aim of this course is to provide a broad understanding on how to manage data, the process of preparing data for analysis, basics of analytics, using AI to automate financial analysis process and generate accounting reports. This course will equip you with the ability to write customized solutions to make informed business decisions, integrate statistical libraries for data analysis, create AI models to automate accounting and financial process. ... We utilize R and Python language as the medium of learning ... You will utilise modern development tools to turn information into insights including Keras' Deep Learning model, Google Brain TensorFlow, Hadoop, Spark and Cloud.

matchedSkills: using AI to automate financial analysis and generate accounting reports
using modern tools (Keras, TensorFlow, Hadoop, Spark, Cloud) to automate accounting and finance processes

financial-analyst.rationale: Building predictive models and automating financial analysis in R/Python is directly the modelling analysts do to analyse company performance.

forensic-accountant.rationale: Using AI on prepared data to flag anomalies maps onto finding the outlier in a large population of transactions during a fraud investigation.

courses.name: Business Valuation: From Theory to Practice
taughtSkills: conducting business valuation using recognized approaches and methods
valuing businesses and equity for transaction purposes
understanding valuation terms, definitions, and premises of value
analyzing discounts/premiums in valuing public and private companies
courses.levelNote: Prerequisite is a single intro-level accounting course (AC1102 OR AD1101 OR AC1104 OR AD1102), so 2000-level.

evidence.quote: This course provides students with the conceptual background, practical skills and knowledge that are necessary to conduct business valuation in the marketplace. ... it will provide an insight into the international valuation standards promulgated by the International Valuation Standards Council (IVSC) and in-depth coverage on the valuation process ... A detailed study of the various valuation approaches and methods commonly used to value business and equity for transactions purposes will also be carried out. ... the course will also address the challenges encountered by valuers relating to discounts/ premiums and valuation of public listed entities and private companies.

courses.name: Forensic Accounting & Fraud Investigation
taughtSkills: IT forensics and social media tracing for evidence examination
analyzing fraudulent schemes (financial statement, cash receipt/disbursement, defalcation, cybercrime)
understanding the role of an expert witness
courses.levelNote: Prerequisite is a single intro-level accounting course (AC1102 OR AD1101 OR AC1104 OR AD1102), so 2000-level.

evidence.quote: The course provides an understanding of white collar crimes in Singapore by analyzing real case studies of major crimes. Students will be taught the investigation methodology in the detection of fraud and the use of information technology forensics and social media tracing to examine documents and evidence within the Singapore legal, regulatory and professional rule-based environment. Various fraudulent schemes will be examined including financial statements, cash receipt, cash disbursement, defalcation and cybercrimes. Finally, the course teaches students effective interviewing and interrogation techniques, and the role of an expert witness.

matchedSkills: Working with law enforcement and legal counsel

courses.name: Strategic Management
taughtSkills: analyzing external and internal environments of a firm
evaluating sources of superior firm performance using conceptual frameworks
incorporating corporate governance considerations into strategy
critically analyzing business issues from a strategic perspective
courses.levelNote: Prerequisite requires two prior 1000-level courses together (AB1501 & AB1601), and the description targets 'final-year' students, indicating a deeper chain (3000).

evidence.quote: The purpose of the Strategic Management Course is to develop your knowledge and skills to identify and evaluate the sources of superior firm performance through using conceptual frameworks. You will learn to analyze the external and internal environments of the firm, formulate and execute different types of strategies with the consideration of good corporate governance. This course is appropriate for final-year accounting and business students who have already taken entry-level courses in accounting ratio analyses, organizational behaviour and marketing.

management-accountant.rationale: Analyzing firm performance drivers and strategy execution supports performance reporting and operational recommendations to management.

corporate-finance-analyst.rationale: Evaluating sources of superior firm performance and strategy/governance frameworks informs the strategic context behind capital and financing decisions.

courses.name: Sustainability Reporting
taughtSkills: applying ESG reporting standards (TCFD, GRI, IR, SASB, ISSB)
measuring and communicating corporate sustainability performance
understanding mandatory sustainability reporting requirements for listed companies
courses.levelNote: Prerequisite is AC3104, itself a course with prerequisites, so this is a deeper chain (3000).

evidence.quote: corporations both small and large are reporting their sustainability (or Environmental, Societal and Governance [ESG]) efforts and performance. In many countries, sustainability reporting is a mandatory requirement, especially for listed companies. ... The focus of this course will be on both preparing and interpreting sustainability and integrated reports. This course covers some of the key existing standards used for environmental, social and governance (ESG) such as Task Force on Climate Related Financial Disclosures (TCFD), Global Reporting Initiatives (GRI), Integrated Reporting (IR), Sustainability Reporting Standards Board (SASB) and International Sustainability Standards Board (ISSB).

financial-accountant.rationale: Preparing and interpreting sustainability/integrated reports under ESG standards (GRI, TCFD, ISSB) is an extension of standards-based financial reporting and mandatory disclosure.

external-auditor.rationale: Understanding mandatory ESG reporting standards and interpreting reports prepared by others supports the growing assurance work over sustainability disclosures.
